Process subsequent simulated director requests through the installed workflows automatically, choosing response, extraction, continuity and authority judgments yourself. Do not receive prepared response text or prepared creative record payloads from the parent. Use local record constructors and production save; sources must resolve exact real current message spans. Preserve all relevant capture kinds, questions/session links and record history. Save before displaying the exact reply with no unsaved suffix or report, no extra memory citation. A normal-filesystem scoped retry is allowed if sandbox hard links are denied; retain IDs and pending payload and never bypass locks. Retain all future per-turn input/capture/payload/save/report files under local/evidence with case IDs supplied by parent; reports identify record IDs and versions but do not self-award semantic correctness. Reports must include full save result as compact JSON printed to command output so the parent can establish save-before-display ordering.
